Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh'lainn Blaze...
A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss's holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest...

Rikki sets Cleo up at a karaoke contest as a joke, where she is humiliated due to her lack of talent. However, her singing ability undergoes a dramatic change when, in spite of the girls' precautions, she is hypnotized by the full moon.
When the mysterious, old Miss Chatham's boat and home is declared unseaworthy, Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him but he sees a tail.

Cleo's 16th birthday is approaching and she thinks that her father is going to throw another embarrasing birthday party. Meanwhile, Zane tries to find the 'sea monster' that he saw when he almost drowned.

Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?
A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.
A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.
Gingka and Pegasus absorb the power at Hades City's reactor and prevent a meltdown.
An undefeated Blader named Zyro Kurogane travels to a big city, where he loses his first battle to a famous Blader by the name of Shinobu Hiryuin.
Zyro tires of training and challenges Eight to bey battle in the Cyclone Beystadium.
Benkei sponsors a one-day bey tournament, where Zyro defeats Shinobu in the final to avenge his earlier loss.
Zyro battles Kite and defeats him, but in a rematch, Kite claims victory to even the score.
In a rematch, Zyro uses Synchrome to combine his bey Ifrit with Shinobu's bey Salamander to defeat the Unabara brothers' bey Orochi Leviathan.
At the witches’ academy, the Sabrina and Cassandra learn about the dangers of using magic carelessly.
Shakespeare’s Puck leads us into this Bard-inspired story. and makes Sabrina the director.
Salem is terrified to learn that the evil Toc-Toc is being released from suspended animation (a Netherworld corrections facility) for a crime Salem committed!

Sabrina and Maritza unsuccessfully try to convince Cassandra that littering isn’t cool. The trash in Greendale is so bad, that these “best friends for life” get their favorite skateboard star, Ricky Speed, to come and perform and clean up the pollution.
Sabrina is excited when Maritza asks her to go to the Plain Brain concert, but when her aunts invite her on a trip to the hyper spa at the same time as the concert.

Archie and the gang get a taste of what it's like to deal with teenagers when Mr. Weatherbee, Mr. Lodge and Miss Grundy drink bottles of contaminated water, causing them to revert to their wild teenage selves.
Archie is temporarily unable to type, so Reggie offers to write the Weird Mystery article for the school paper.
A monstrous man of incredible strength is making evening appearances in Riverdale.
Zane hears of a treasure under the ocean and enlists the girls to find it. Rikki is injured in the search. Zane gives Rikki the reward. Charlotte contrives to keep Lewis from the girls.
Emma starts acting weird after pricking her finger on a barb of coral. Cleo’s fish Hector exhibits the same behaviour. Emma becomes more and more like a fish and Lewis has to find a way to cure her.

Don takes the family camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. The girls are affected and need the moon pool for sanctuary. Charlotte almost slips in the moon pool and realises something weird is going on there.

Emma thinks she’s going to get a promotion at the juice bar but Ash is given the job. Emma and Ash clash over the job, but we discover it’s over a lot more. Meanwhile, Lewis stands up to Charlotte over spending time with Cleo.
Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true – the scent of ambergris sends them wild. But it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and has all three mermaid girls on his arm!
During Errie's annual Tornado day, Matt Frewer drops in as a wacky meteorologist whom Marshall helps battle Tornado Bob.
Marshall and Simon are startled by a creepy kid who's living in an old mill that's haunted by the ghost of Eerie's worst bank robber ever.
It's a dark and stormy night when Mildred and Camille's car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.
A Mad Scientist went missing in the 1930's.
Seventeen year old Nathan is a star athlete who would do anything to play pro basketball.
During a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Gus' powers mysteriously begin to fail while fending off Zarlak's forces. Investigation reveals that the magic-loss is affecting Gus' whole Elfin family.
Scott has to watch over Grandpa for the weekend while Grandma is out of town, but it's the same weekend as the school picnic. Grandpa tags along with Scott and his friends, leaving Scott embarrassed.

The werewolf mascot costume is stolen by the uppity Upson High boys, right before the big game. Scott and Stiles must outsmart the snobbish Upson boys in order to retrieve the costume, or they'll have to find a new mascot entirely.

Scott and his family volunteer on a farm for a week, but it proves to be a lot more work than they've expected. The animals sense that the Howards are werewolves and flee, leaving the Howards responsible for finding them before the farmer's return.

The town statue is stolen by a couple of crooks who ask for ransom money. The Howards learn that the inside of the statue contains the diary of their distant werewolf relative, and grow concerned that the diary could get into the wrong hands.
When Reggie falls in love with a B-movie queen, he buys a magical potion to bring her out of the film and into Riverdale.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Beware of the Glob!
programmes.d: When Miss Beazely mistakenly uses water from one of Dilton's experiments for her school lunch pudding mix, the school dessert comes to life.

'The Inspector's Most Wanted': A criminal from The Inspector's past seeks revenge by having him perform on the all-too-realistic Cop Patrol television show. 'Pinky Appleseed,' Pinky's efforts to re-plant a forest are obstructed by Paul Bunyan.

'Calling Dr. Panther': The Panther must save his Boss from the clutches of a mad doctor. 'For Those Who Pink Young': The Panther gets a child's view of the world when he is accidentally shrunk to kid-size by Professor Von Schmarty's fun machine.

A chemical accident caused by Coconuts ends up giving superpowers to Robotnik, who quickly uses them to threaten Mobius's world leaders and publicly humiliate Sonic. However, Robotnik isn't completely invincible.
An asteroid is heading for Turtle Town and Robotnik offers to save it, but only if Sonic agrees to play in the Robolympics against him and his robots.
Sonic becomes the sheriff of Tranquil Gulch, in hopes of keeping Robotnik's robots from harassing the locals.

Robotnik goes time-traveling to find four Chaos Emeralds that could make him all-powerful. His first stop is the time of Blackbeard the Pirate, where he enlists the pirate's help to find the Emerald of Invisibility.
Chief Quimby and Penny aid Inspector Gadget in rescuing three famous oceanographers who are kidnapped by M.A.D
Dr. Focus of M.A.D. invents a machine called Sneezooka which creates the wind of 3 billion sneezes. Inspector Gadget finds the secret laboratory and destroys the machine.
Mr. Bean finds himself with more than a spring in his step. Mr. Bean likes nothing more than to relax on his sofa with a good meal and his favourite telly programme.

A puzzling puzzle has Mr. Bean truly puzzled. In a dark and cobwebby corner of his attic, Mr. Bean finds a treasure map. The hunt is on! But tricky clues lead Bean up the chimney, round the bend, down the garden path.

Mr. Bean needs to let a room but no one will let him. After a regrettable episode involving his landlady sleepwalking into his room, Mr. Bean suddenly finds himself out on his ear with nowhere to live.

Mr. Bean discovers the great outdoors is not always so great. An old photo album causes Bean to reminisce about his lovely summers at scout camp as a boy and sets him planning a night under the stars with Teddy.
Mr. Bean’s hobby goes down in flames in his battle for air supremacy. When his model aeroplane is blown out of the sky by that of a rival kid, Mr. Bean sets his sights on revenge.
When a lucky coin is stolen from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, it triggers a market crash, threatening even the vast wealth of the Ripley fortune.
